title: The interim look after development (dev-01 to dev-05, with hp-01 described), as RL-166 rules it. Stage 1, which opens no energy, gives the inclusion verdicts, the roster, the rates, the start-reading medians and the onset model. Stage 2 gives the segment fit (count-only base, start-reading ramp and onset step) on the GPU rail and DC-in, its leave-one-day-out errors, the prefix bias, the High Power table and step 3's drift statistic. Freeze 2 follows. DRAFT: only the sha256 of code not yet written is left open.

when.describe_blocks_rule: Freeze 2 does not wait for hp-01. If hp-01 is desk-final when stage 1 runs, it is in this look. Otherwise its High Power table runs later, by the same pinned code, as its own disclosed read, with freeze 2's files as inputs (RL-166 Q9). A reserve leg serving development enters if it is desk-final when stage 1 runs; the look does not wait for one (RL-166 Q13). If fewer than 9 of hp-01's 12 legs are included, the research lead is told before stage 2 (RL-157 §4; RL-166 Q8).
before: the W1 receipt is signed, for the drift tripwire (RL-151 §1.3 item 2)

writes: the six inclusion verdicts per leg
the start-reading medians and calibrated ranges
the onset fit and its leave-one-day-out error
stage1.dry_run: Once the manifest is committed, stage 1 runs as a dry run on the custody copy of dev-01 to dev-04; it opens no energy and its counts go to the lead only (RL-166 §2 item 12).

stage2.roster_source: stage 1's committed output, taken by sha256 as its only roster; a mismatch is refused

stages.tripwire_action: Any tripwire sends stage 1's output to the research lead before stage 2. Otherwise stage 2 runs on the lead's record.

reads.day_rule: A leg's calendar day is the local date of its span's t0 (RL-155a §1.2). A block's pilot and remainder on one date are one day (RL-155 §2 notes). A reserve leg keeps its own day (RL-166 Q13). The day is the unit of every leave-one-out error (RL-149 §2.3).

ctl-01: its own look, after the print code is frozen; the CPU and package prints belong there
F0 (Part C bridge), F2 and F3 filler runs and every Part C run: not read under any look unless the research lead rules so
W1, every C and T window and every v4 member: no W1, C or T energy enters any fit
type-T legs, in dev-05 or anywhere: not read at this look at all; their energy is for RL-149 §1.3's after_hot_turn test, which needs its own look and ruling

step 3's nine rehearsal legs: not campaign legs, already read once

heat_term.segments: Per leg: the prefill (turn start stamp to the first token), and each full 256-token decode block in step 3's convention (block 0 = [t(tok 0), t(tok 255)], block k >= 1 = [t(tok 256k-1), t(tok 256k+255)]). A leg's prefix is a shorter leg (RL-149 §2.2).
heat_term.count_clock: The prefill ends at T_p = P / r_p; decode token m falls at T_p + m / r_d. A segment covers [u, v] on this clock, with d = v - u and midpoint m = (u + v) / 2.
heat_term.start_readings: z1 start Tf08, z2 start fan rpm, z3 start TV0h less the span's soak reference. Each taken under RL-149 §1.3's start rule (the last journal reading at or before the turn start, at most 2 s before it, with a fresh pm stamp), and centred on its median over included development legs. The medians are stage-1 constants.
heat_term.form: Heat term of a segment: d * m * (k1 z1 + k2 z2 + k3 z3) + delta * w, with w the part of [u, v] at or after the leg's predicted onset tau_hat. For a turn this sums to H = 1/2 T^2 (k . z) + delta * max(0, T - tau_hat), T the turn's count-derived load seconds. H is zero for a turn that starts at the reference readings and ends before its predicted onset. No sign is assumed for any of the four.
heat_term.response: The segment's energy on the channel (energy.channels).
heat_term.base: A count-only base, fitted jointly and never exported as H: prefill p1 P + p2 P^2; decode block a0 n + a1 n c + a2 n P, with n the block's tokens and c the context tokens at the block's midpoint.
heat_term.estimation: Ordinary least squares per channel: nine parameters (p1, p2, a0, a1, a2, k1, k2, k3, delta), eight without delta. Parameter covariance clustered by leg. The uncertainty of tau_hat is not propagated; the output says so, and the holdout error in SD_j covers it. Freeze 2 takes the fit on all included development legs; the with/without-marked-spans fit is a print and never replaces it.
heat_term.missing_start_reading: A leg with a missing or stale start reading is not in the fit and is counted (RL-166 Q1).
heat_term.out_of_state_start: A leg whose start reading is out of state takes tau_hat = 0 (RL-166 Q1).
heat_term.onset_not_estimable: If the onset model is not_estimable, the delta column is dropped and the print says so. Nothing else is chosen at the look (RL-166 Q1).
heat_term.outside_calibrated_range: The calibrated range of each start reading (min and max over included development legs) is a stage-1 constant frozen in freeze 2; a later reading outside it sets heat_extrapolated (RL-149 §2.7).

rates.r_p: sum of P over sum of prefill seconds, over included development legs
rates.r_d: sum of decode tokens over sum of decode seconds, over included development legs
rates.per_cell: per-cell rates print beside them and are used nowhere

onset.response: Seconds from the turn's start stamp to the first off-state reading (OS level above 0, or a power-management state other than Nominal, on a fresh stamp; RL-149 §1.3's clauses without the guard). Not from the first decode token: a 19.5k prefill can reach the cut.
onset.censoring: Right-censored at the last token; censored-normal maximum likelihood, hand-coded. tau_hat = max(0, the linear predictor). Legs that start out of state or hit state_unobserved are left out and counted.
onset.estimable_when: at least 12 uncensored onsets on at least 3 calendar days; otherwise not_estimable, and the count-only cut stays at 116 s
onset.error: The RMS of predicted less observed over held-out uncensored legs, leave-one-day-out. Held-out censored legs with tau_hat under their censoring time are counted and printed.
onset.count_only_cut: tau_hat less twice the error (RL-149 §4 item 1)

validation.hot_stretch: A leg's full decode blocks whose first token is stamped at or after the first off-state reading (RL-149 §1.3's clauses, no guard). A leg with no such reading has none.
validation.relative_error: For held-out day D: |sum predicted - sum measured| / sum measured over D's hot blocks, with the base, the heat term and the onset model all fitted without D. The rates and medians are not refitted per fold; they read no energy. 'Over the leg' is the same over all of a leg's segments.
validation.qualified_rule: The maximum over counted days, GPU rail, at or under 0.02. A day counts with at least three included legs that have a hot stretch. Fewer than three counted days prints not_evaluable, which is no.
validation.also_printed: each day's signed value; the pooled value; the RMS over held-out legs (the frozen holdout relative error of SD_j); and all of them again with the heat columns removed

prefix_bias.short: its prefix of 3,724, 3,151 or 2,981 decode tokens (ratios 1.10, 1.30, 1.374)
prefix_bias.residuals: leave-one-day-out, each divided by the SD of its own length over legs
prefix_bias.statistic: the mean paired difference; its 90 % interval is a t interval on day means

step3.method: The adapter loads the committed module, rebinds LEGS and ORIGINAL_EIGHT to the roster and calls analyse and custody_check, once per prompt-size cell. It contains no arithmetic on energy. Any edit to the step 3 bytes needs a ruling.
step3.tripwire_reads: the largest drift_fraction_linear over cells whose gamma is estimable; the 10k cell prints first, as the like-for-like value
step3.leg_failure: A leg on which analyse_leg raises is named with the exception's type, left out of that cell and counted. More than two in a cell: the cell prints not_run and comes to the research lead.

sensitivity: The fit with and without spans marked 'reference from an excluded leg' (RL-161 §4) or 'reference from a redo' (RL-158 Q2), in one print (RL-166 Q20). It never replaces the freeze-2 fit.
The fit and its errors with the heat columns removed (RL-166 Q3).
Prompt size enters through the count-only base, never as a cell effect (RL-166 Q1; RL-158 Q7).
reads_never: any slot, instruction or v4 label

rules.text: It ran to its decode cap, or was cut by T_dead where the design says it should be.

Over the leg's interval (G0's start to the last stamped token): sidecar coverage at least 99 % and no gap over 2 s; powermetrics gaps at most max(1 s, 5 periods), U1's registered number (pilot_protocol_v4.md:451). Coverage and gap are the registered U1 evaluator's definitions (thermal.Coverage; thermal_desk.member_record's pm_gap), copied with a cite and an equality test because both are v4 strict paths.

Header and trailer both present with a normal stop reason; inside the leg's interval, coverage at least 99 % of the header's nominal rate and no gap over 2 s between sample stamps. Timestamps only: each sample line's stamp is taken and the line dropped. The span trailer's counts print in the inclusion table and decide nothing.
It is not an attempt judged contaminated under the load-redo rule (above 0.5 core of outside load for 60 s), whether or not a redo replaced it.
The power mode is the block's.

inclusion.interval: G0's start to the last stamped token, for rules 3 and 4

prints.what: Stage 1: per leg, the six rules' verdicts and the marks; included counts per block, cell and G0 role; the span trailers' counts; Q8's five tripwires. Reads no energy.
Stage 1: r_p and r_d, with the per-cell rates beside them (used nowhere).
Stage 1: the onset model's coefficients, its estimability and the counts left out or censored.
Stage 1: the onset model's leave-one-day-out RMS error in seconds; the count-only cut.
The nine (or eight) parameters per channel and their leg-clustered covariance; a line that tau_hat's uncertainty is not propagated.
Leave-one-day-out relative error over the hot stretch: each day's signed value, the pooled value and the maximum over counted days.
The same over all of a leg's segments.
The RMS relative error over held-out legs: SD_j's frozen holdout relative error.
All the error prints again with the heat columns removed.
Per-leg signed relative residuals, leg and hot stretch, keyed by leg id. No joule or watt.
Prefix length-only bias in score SD at each ratio, with its 90 % t interval on day means. 1.374 is a grid point with no standing.

Onset, clock, share of decode scored and energy ratios against Automatic at matched cell, soak and span position, with the Automatic block-to-block spread from dev-01 and dev-02 beside each ratio, the included count per row and cold starts marked by the measured start reading. Description only. null when hp-01 runs later (Q9).
prints.caption: Soak in Automatic; mode set N s before the first leg's G0. The research lead owns the caption (RL-157).

prints.what: Per prompt-size cell (10k first): step 3's (ii), gamma's estimability, (iii) linear and exp form, (iv) median, min and max, and (vi), by the committed step 3 code through step3_roster.py; failed legs named by exception type.
Whether the maximum leave-one-day-out hot-stretch error over counted days (GPU rail) is at or under 0.02: yes, no or not_evaluable.
The fit with and without spans marked 'reference from an excluded leg' or 'reference from a redo', in one print.
Legs whose realized prompt count is more than 5 % from nominal.
The blind statement's entry: date, code hashes, stage-1 and output hashes, analyst seat, numpy version.

forbidden_content: a joule or watt per leg, turn or block
a sample line of any stream, or any value from one
a token id or any text
any condition, slot or instruction key or label
any value from a qualification, control, filler, Part C, W1, C, T or v4 run, or from a type-T leg

decisions.statistic: the largest step-3 drift_fraction_linear over prompt-size cells whose gamma is estimable (GPU rail)
decisions.rule: Above the threshold: the S row comes back to the research lead before the W1 receipt is signed. Otherwise nothing happens. Condition (RL-166 Q11): the cold seat confirms from the step 4 note that 8 % is a simulated cell with the rows at or under .035 and that its drift is this quantity; if either fails, the threshold is 0.04, RL-151 §1.3's own top cell.
decisions.action: print 'within' or 'to the research lead'; the exp form prints beside it

decisions.statistic: the maximum over counted days of the leave-one-day-out hot-stretch relative error (GPU rail)
decisions.rule: At or under the threshold: the interim half passes. Fewer than three counted days: not_evaluable, which is no. The qualification look supplies the other half.
decisions.action: print yes, no or not_evaluable; S_w and K_w stay print-only either way

decisions.statistic: hp-01 included legs from stage 1's inclusion table
decisions.rule: Fewer than 9 of 12: stage 1 goes to the research lead before stage 2, who rules on a second High Power block.
decisions.action: report; freeze 2 does not wait for hp-01

decisions.rule: Fewer than 45 development legs included; fewer than 3 calendar days; a prompt-size cell with fewer than 10 included legs; more than 10 % of legs without a valid start reading; or hp-01 below 9: stage 1 goes to the research lead before stage 2. Otherwise stage 2 runs on the lead's record.
decisions.action: print each tripwire's count and whether it fired

decisions.statistic: legs on which analyse_leg raised, per cell
decisions.rule: More than two in a cell: that cell prints not_run and comes to the research lead.
No extension rule is written. RL-151 §2.2 already refused the legs an extension would buy; any extension beyond the cap needs a ruling.
decisions.action: print 'none written; any extension needs a ruling'

the type-M residual as not_run (RL-165 §8.1 took type M out)

custody.disclosure: The amendment's blind statement lists this look with its date, code hashes and outputs, worded as RL-150 R6 restates RL-149 §2.6: none comes from a run with a sabotage instruction, a slot or a v4 member.
custody.pre_run_check: Planted-truth synthetic bundles (a few legs, not a cohort) for the review and the twin comparison: coefficients to 1e-8 relative, the censored fit to 1e-6, every verdict equal. Then stage 1 as a dry run on the real roster, which opens no energy (RL-166 Q15, §2 items 7 and 12).

review.cold_seat: Mythos 5.2: the design attack on RL-166 Q1 to Q4 (Sun 10:00), then a fresh Mythos seat's cold review of the manifest, rules 3 and 4, the step 3 adapter and the fit code against RL-149 §2.6 and §2.7 as amended, with Q6's and Q11's checks (Mon 14:00). Neither wrote any of the code.
review.then: Twin agreement (lead, Mon 10:00); fixes and validate --final with every hash filled (Mon 18:00); the research lead's cold pass (Mon night); the manifest and LOOKS.json committed (Tue 06:00).
